rules.use: A number may go into a public reply only if its public_url is set: that is the free page where the reader sees the same text. public_url null = not shown on any free page, do not use in public text. Checked by scripts/check_reply_numbers.py.
rules.stale: load_reply_module refuses after the deadline, when a source was regenerated and a selected number would now display differently, or when a named player's FPL status, chance or news changed.

captain_top5.rule: GW xP top 5, at most 2 per club (same selection as goaliq.app/fpl/best-captain)

xp_top5.rule: GW xP top 5, at most 3 per club (same list as goaliq.app/fpl/expected-points#gw-xp)

differentials.rule: owned 10% or less, ranked by 6-gameweek xP (same list as goaliq.app/fpl/differentials)

model_vs_template.reason: model squad for GW6 not frozen yet (it is frozen about a day before the deadline)
